subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback-host validation and a derived redirect URI, including fail-closed behavior for previously accepted non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes a shipped env-var behavior on credential acquisition and the security framing depends on maintainer intent under the documented trusted-operator environment model.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the patch matches the sibling OpenAI OAuth pattern.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Anthropic token-exchange proof for the allowed redirect spellings before accepting provider-side redirect compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause For Anthropic OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want to deprecate or replace the legacy direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it incrementally.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the patch matches the sibling OpenAI OAuth pattern.
